title: Source inventory metadata page-check gate
summary: This iteration strengthens the source-first daily page checklist so the 154-row source inventory cannot regress into a name-only list; each row must keep logical-source mapping and source metadata, and the status focus must keep runtime status labels visible.

degraded_sections.message: The real 2026-06-29 page-check still reports the existing community_cards_reader_facing degraded check, but no blocking checks are present and this iteration does not modify community card rendering.

lessons.lesson: A complete inventory row count is insufficient evidence for source-first visibility.
lessons.evidence: The red E2E stripped inventory rows down to 154 source names; before this phase, `source_first_public_contract` still passed because it only counted `li strong` nodes.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep row-level logical-source mapping and metadata counts inside the page checklist whenever the inventory contract is refined.

lessons.lesson: The 154-row inventory is a collection-entry layer, while daily runtime status belongs to the logical source status focus/map.
lessons.evidence: The implementation validates collection-entry metadata in inventory rows and validates runtime status labels in `#section-source-status-focus`.
lessons.recommended_action: Avoid treating every collection entry as a daily logical-source status row unless the data model is explicitly expanded.

lessons.lesson: Real-page check details should be useful for diagnosis, not just boolean pass/fail.
lessons.evidence: The real 2026-06-29 page-check reports `rows:154`, `rows_with_logical_mapping:154`, `rows_with_metadata:154`, empty `missing_metadata_samples`, and status labels for blocked/skipped/updated/no-recent/parsed states.
lessons.recommended_action: Continue adding actionable counts and samples to blocking page checks so future failures can be repaired without guesswork.

followups.action: Continue the source-first roadmap by auditing whether collection entries should ever receive per-entry runtime status, or whether logical-source status remains the correct daily runtime layer.
